text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll go get the food for us!
I have the perfect morning recommendations♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such a voice echoed through the cafeteria in the morning.
Turning my gaze toward the sound, who should be there but Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um... When I mentioned I hadn't had breakfast yet, they invited me to join them... and besides—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...The people behind Spe-san
also asked me to, so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
……No. ……It's no trouble at all……
……If it's just keeping an eye on
Spe-san's nutritional balance……

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Just a moment ago—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......You sure brought... a lot.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ten servings of hamburg steaks to give you the strength of a hundred people!
One kilogram of carrot pasta, a morning essential!
And a mountain of fruit salad for dessert!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you eat this, there's no doubt
you'll be full of energy all day long♪
choice_data_list: Could I get a share of that too?
Eat it all up and get full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you eat this, there's no doubt
you'll be full of energy all day long♪
choice_data_list: Could I get a share of that too?
Eat it all up and get full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Let's all enjoy eating together♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...When eating together with everyone, it really fills you up
even if there isn't much food, doesn't it...
choice_data_list: That was a well-balanced meal, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It feels a little lacking to me...
Maybe I'll order some more...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ "Eating until eighty percent full is the secret to good health"...
...is it...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh... Why do you know Mom's catchphrase...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Have I told you before?
My birth mother
often used to say that.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, I just happened to overhear someone close to Spe-san say so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah... I see! Could it be Suzuka-san?
Or maybe Sei-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... you're right.
I'll pass on eating today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu... yes...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes—well then, before we eat...
let us divide the portions—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Why, why... is it all salads...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Overeating isn't good for you... Besides,
this way offers much better nutritional balance...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aww, no way~...
At least give me one more hamburger steak~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ouchâ!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Did someone just bonk me on the head............?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Well then, let us partake...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaah......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Manhattan Cafe finished every last bit of the massive breakfast.
